notes.connections: Lines reproduce four published Hyperline run traces in their original order. Numbered sections are guide annotations. The map is a 2D projection: doors, jumps and floors require the source reference. These are lane-return box runs, not invented camp tours or a verified Green-to-mid farming rotation.
notes.math: The source traces do not include collected loot, pickup counts or floor heights. Route totals and souls-per-minute estimates are therefore not reported. Per-box estimates use the current shared clock; actual regular-box drops are random. Practice-run durations are distinct from match-start checks and are not beginner completion guarantees.
notes.scope: Four published box-farming runs. Camp kills and Sinner jackpots are not added to their paths. A complete sourced Green-to-mid camp/Sinner rotation could not be verified.

profiles.title: Green: full return loop
profiles.purpose: After a pushed Green wave, sweep the back-lane boxes and return to Green.
profiles.windowLabel: From 3:00, after securing and pushing your wave. Prefer a covered lane or a longer gap; this is not a guaranteed one-wave detour.
profiles.risk: Enemy pressure, missing loot and floor changes can make a practiced run unsuitable for the current wave gap.
profiles.timeBudget: 54.45 s in the source practice run. This is an extended circuit: use it when lane coverage allows it, and allow more time while learning the movement.
profiles.summary: The published HK Right Long recording follows a broad loop through the inner block, back street and chapel side before returning to Green.
profiles.why: Use the wave to create the farming window. The published route supplies the path; live lane pressure determines whether to complete it.
preflight: Secure and push the available wave before leaving.
Check the exit, missing enemies and whether your partner can hold the lane.
Learn the source route in Explore NYC before relying on its practice timing.
abort: The next wave reaches an unsafe position or your lane partner needs help.
The boxes are already cleared, the route costs too much health, or an enemy blocks the exit.
profiles.exitRule: Finish on Green at the recorded endpoint. Reassess the wave before starting any other route.
